usage.callShape: POST https://stableenrich.dev/api/clado/contacts-enrich with JSON body containing exactly one of {linkedin_url|email|phone}
usage.outputShape: body.data[0].social[] (array of {link,type,rating}); body.data[0].contacts[] (personal email/phone when available); body.data[0].error (bool)
quirks: contacts[] may be empty even on a successful 200 (no personal email/phone found for that subject); social[] is the primary populated result
result wrapped in a top-level data[] array — read body.data[0]
usage.guide: POST to https://stableenrich.dev/api/clado/contacts-enrich with a JSON body holding exactly one identifier: {linkedin_url}, {email}, or {phone}. Pay x402 (~$0.20 USDC on Base), synchronous. Read the result at body.data[0]: contacts[] holds personal email/phone when found, social[] holds matched social profiles ({link,type,rating}). Note contacts[] can be empty on a valid 200.
